subject: Startups
title: Zoom's Frictionless Invite
description: A 60-second lesson on Zoom's Frictionless Invite.

hook.text: Zoom had a killer viral mechanic. To join a meeting, you didn't even need an account. Just click a link.

buildup.text: Every Zoom meeting with an outsider was a demo. The guest experienced the product firsthand, with zero friction.

discovery.text: One paid user could expose dozens of non-users to Zoom weekly. Each meeting was a free trial for everyone invited.

twist.text: Competitors required accounts for all participants. That tiny barrier killed their viral potential completely.

climax.text: By 2020, Zoom had 300 million daily participants. The frictionless invite had done most of the heavy lifting.

punchline.text: Remove the sign-up wall and usage becomes marketing.

quiz.question: What made Zoom's viral loop so effective?
options: No account needed to join meetings
